algorithm: Circuit constrains 32-bit epoch-day fields, a Poseidon credential commitment, EdDSA issuer authentication, dob <= cutoff and now <= expiry. Public challenge binds a nullifier to audience and nonce. References: https://github.com/iden3/circomlib and https://github.com/iden3/snarkjs .
architecture: Default: mock issuer → plaintext policy checks → replay ledger. Optional: issuer EdDSA → private witness → Circom R1CS/WASM → Groth16 → verifier policy binding → nonce consumption.
data_model: Circuit private inputs: DOB, expiry, salt, commitment and signature. Public signals in order: nullifier output, issuerAx, issuerAy, cutoff, now, nonce, audience. No name is required.
description: A credential policy reference plus an actual Circom age/expiry/signature circuit and optional Groth16 issuer/prover/verifier scripts.
design: The verifier must choose and trust public keys, cutoff, now, audience and challenge rather than trusting prover-selected values. Dates are epoch days computed outside the circuit; the issuer validates real dates. Setup toxic waste and witness files require secure handling.
family_notes: Accept a trusted credential that meets cutoff and expiry policy.
Reject a birthdate later than the verifier cutoff.
Reject a credential from an untrusted issuer.
Reject reuse of an already consumed challenge.
limitations: Default Python execution is NOT a ZK proof and reveals private fields to its evaluator. SHA-256/HMAC mocks are distinct from the Poseidon/EdDSA circuit and are not interoperable. Circom, circomlib and snarkjs execution/trusted setup were unavailable here; circuit and proof paths are unvalidated sources. No DID registry, revocation tree, Rust implementation or audited cryptographic protocol. A nonce ledger needs transactional storage and challenge expiry in a real service.
operations: Use synthetic credentials. Install optional JS dependencies only to develop the circuit path. Supply a reviewed Powers of Tau and circuit-specific final zkey; no ceremony artifacts or private issuer keys are bundled.
scope: Default plaintext policy evaluator with HMAC mock credentials and replay ledger. Optional Circom circuit binds private DOB/expiry/salt to an issuer EdDSA-Poseidon signature, date cutoff and fresh audience/nonce. Node scripts issue witnesses, generate Groth16 proofs and verify trusted public signals.
security: The mock key is public demo material. Never use it with real credentials. The generated cryptographic path is unaudited and unexecuted; protect witnesses, use a reviewed setup and trusted verifier policy before experimentation.
title: Zero-Knowledge Decentralized Identity Protocol
